# TypeZero

> Ultra-low-latency native macOS AI voice dictation & Typeless-grade text structuring — built in pure Swift + C++, MIT open-source, $0 subscription forever.

TypeZero is a free, open-source, Apple-notarized macOS (Apple Silicon arm64, macOS 14.0+) AI voice input and semantic formatting app designed as a zero-subscription, privacy-first alternative to Typeless, Wispr Flow, Superwhisper, and Shandianshuo (闪电说).

## Official Links

- Homepage (Simplified Chinese): https://typezero.mykkai.com/
- Homepage (English): https://typezero.mykkai.com/en/
- Homepage (Japanese): https://typezero.mykkai.com/ja/
- TypeZero vs Typeless (Chinese): https://typezero.mykkai.com/vs-typeless/
- TypeZero vs Shandianshuo / 闪电说 (Chinese): https://typezero.mykkai.com/vs-shandianshuo/
- Direct macOS DMG Download (v0.4.10): https://typezero.mykkai.com/downloads/TypeZero-v0.4.10-macOS-arm64.dmg
- GitHub Repository (MIT License): https://github.com/nasadunadu/TypeZero

## Core Capabilities

- **Tri-Engine Acoustic Recognition**:
  - Volcengine Seed-ASR 2.0 native binary WebSocket streaming (~121ms tail latency)
  - OpenAI (`gpt-4o-mini-transcribe` / `gpt-4o-transcribe`) & Groq (`whisper-large-v3-turbo`) cloud ASR
  - Embedded C++ `sherpa-onnx` 886MB SenseVoice FP32 local offline engine with automatic zero-dropped-syllable failover
- **BYOK Semantic Formatting (Typeless 5-Pillar Structuring)**:
  - Removes spoken fillers (嗯/啊/那个, um/uh) and mid-sentence self-corrections
  - Auto-formats numbered/bulleted lists, splits long monologues into paragraphs, applies CJK-Latin Pangu spacing, and prevents duplicate Markdown list markers in Cursor, Notion, and Feishu
  - Supports OpenAI GPT, Google Gemini, Anthropic Claude, DeepSeek 4 Flash, Volcengine Doubao-Seed, Alibaba Qwen-Flash, and local Ollama / LM Studio
- **Latency & UX**:
  - `<=28`-char clean short-sentence `0ms` Pass-2 cloud bypass with `~8ms` atomic clipboard-preserving paste
  - Optional live inline typewriter mode (`11ms–18ms`)
  - Full left/right modifier isolation (`Fn`, L/R `⌥`, L/R `⌘`, L/R `⌃`, L/R `⇧`, `⌥+Space`) plus custom Carbon combo recorder
- **Self-Evolving Personal Lexicon**:
  - `<0.5ms` tone-free phonetic fuzzy recall (`zh/z`, `sh/s`, `ing/in`, `n/l`) and word-boundary acronym glide fixes
  - Passive auto-learning from manual edits via Apple `NLTokenizer`
- **Privacy & Security**:
  - 100% local privacy: zero relay servers, zero accounts, zero telemetry
  - API keys encrypted in macOS Keychain (`SecItem`); supports 100% offline operation

## Install via Homebrew

```bash
brew tap nasadunadu/typezero https://github.com/nasadunadu/TypeZero
brew install --cask typezero
```

## Comparison Summary

- **vs Typeless / Wispr Flow**: Same 5-pillar semantic structuring and low latency, but $0/month subscription (MIT open-source BYOK) and optional 100% offline mode.
- **vs 闪电说 (Shandianshuo)**: Open-source MIT license, Apple Developer ID notarized, zero vendor cloud lock-in, full BYOK model freedom.
- **vs macOS Built-in Dictation**: Adds semantic filler removal, self-correction, Markdown list structuring, CJK-Latin spacing, and self-learning personal lexicon.
